title: Volume rendering colormap is not directly exposed
abstract:
### Bug report

It looks to me like the colormap used for volume rendering is currently not exposed to user, and can only be changed by building a custom transfer function from the ground up.
This look like a simple enough change but I'd like someone with more experience in VR to weigh in: what would be the best way to expose this/which user-facing function should expose it (`yt.create_scene` ? `Scene.render` ? `source.set_cmap` in the fashion of `source.set_log` ?) ?

https://yt-project.org/docs/dev/visualizing/volume_rendering.html#volume-rendering-components
